scientific_integrity.computations: Direct prime-field RREF and idempotent-projector exhaustive checks of finite cases; not a proof of all cases.

scientific_integrity.scope: Finite fields of arbitrary characteristic, n>=1, r>=1 central stabilization; r=0 boundary is covered by formulas but not claimed as new qualitative classification.

title: Exact binary-grading counts and central-parity concentration in finite Heisenberg extensions
